clips.title: A small living drift
clips.acting: Wisp gently counterbalances arms and core, glances down at the path, then resumes watching.

clips.title: A wave for the sidewalk
clips.acting: A hesitant finger wave grows into a whole-arm greeting, then the arm relaxes with follow-through.
clips.audioIntent: warm airy brush following the hand
clips.transitionRequirement: At least 0.5 seconds exact black and finished sound tails at each end; no visible-body crossfade; complete one-shot performance.

clips.title: Trying to be frightening
clips.acting: Wisp rehearses a scary pose, startles at its own little spark and sheepishly smooths its crest.
clips.audioIntent: tiny pop; no spoken boo or laugh
clips.transitionRequirement: At least 0.5 seconds exact black and finished sound tails at each end; no visible-body crossfade; complete one-shot performance.

clips.title: Off to the next haunting
clips.acting: A final wave, a real turn away and curved retreat; the complete spirit dissolves intentionally into empty black.

clips.title: A friendly arrival
clips.acting: Empty black gathers into a small fog knot, forming the entire familiar core, hands and crest before greeting.

clips.title: The house is watching
clips.acting: An asymmetrical hover with shoulder weight, searching eyes and slow finger unfurling; never a frozen hold.
clips.audioIntent: very low breathing wind; no voice

clips.title: Guarding the doorway
clips.acting: Wisp paces on a shallow curved path, turns with the travel and shows changing side silhouettes.

clips.title: A hand from the mist
clips.acting: A shoulder-led hand reaches into perspective, fingers fan, then wrist and elbow recover naturally.
clips.audioIntent: finger-linked rising whisper of air, no words
clips.transitionRequirement: At least 0.5 seconds exact black and finished sound tails at each end; no visible-body crossfade; complete one-shot performance.

clips.title: Only the eyes remain
clips.acting: Body vapor disperses deliberately until only floating eyes remain; they glance down, blink, then summon the body back.

clips.title: Back into the house
clips.acting: A complete turn reveals the back; Wisp leaves along a curved route and disappears into distance.

clips.title: Almost a scare
clips.acting: Wisp winds up for a lunge, pauses with living motion, then drifts aside with a wicked grin.

clips.title: A haunting arrival
clips.acting: Empty black forms the scary spirit coherently, then settles into the same menacing anchor pose.

clips.title: The same spirit darkens
clips.acting: Whole-body vapor reshapes; rounded hands lengthen, brows compress and the grin becomes wicked in coordinated order.

clips.title: Welcome, little visitors
clips.acting: Claws round and teeth soften before eyes widen; shoulder weight lifts into familiar friendly Wisp.
clips.audioIntent: tension releases into a warm airy chime

clips.title: A greeting in the mist
clips.acting: Empty black gathers into readable designed HAPPY HALLOWEEN fog lettering; letter edges breathe while the center remains legible, then every letter dissolves completely.
clips.audioIntent: airy letter formation with delicate ghostly shimmer; no voice

clips.title: Bats steal Halloween
clips.acting: The same designed fog lettering forms; a small flock of bats crosses in perspective, their wakes tear the letters into localized vapor until the stage is empty.
clips.audioIntent: restrained wing flutters, a wide airy pass and soft dissipating shimmer

deferredClips.title: Did someone pass?
deferredClips.acting: Eyes lead a head turn; shoulders follow late. A tiny surprised lift settles into recognition.

deferredClips.title: Behind an invisible corner
deferredClips.acting: Wisp turns in perspective, slips sideways into fog, peeks from the same side and eases back.

deferredClips.title: The imaginary candy
deferredClips.acting: Wisp spots an imaginary sweet, cups it, watches it float away and gives an amused silent shrug.

deferredClips.title: One happy twirl
deferredClips.acting: A hand winds the torso into a full turn, showing a painted back before the core unwinds.
deferredClips.audioIntent: rising breeze with a soft landing

deferredClips.title: Happy Halloween
deferredClips.acting: Wisp draws two airy lines with a fingertip. Designed Happy Halloween lettering follows the stroke, lingers, then dissolves as Wisp bows.
deferredClips.audioIntent: chalky shimmer during strokes; gentle sparkle on final dot

deferredClips.title: Thank you for visiting
deferredClips.acting: A modest bow folds shoulders and hands; the lower core trails and catches up.

deferredClips.title: I noticed you
deferredClips.acting: The eyes lock first, chin lowers and the torso turns a beat later toward the approach.

deferredClips.title: The far side of the room
deferredClips.acting: Wisp turns its back and circles through depth, then notices the viewer over its shoulder.
deferredClips.audioIntent: panning wind tied to travel; mono-compatible

deferredClips.title: What are you doing here?
deferredClips.acting: A suspicious head tilt, narrowed lids and deliberate lean; the hands continue a restrained simmer.

deferredClips.title: Counting the visitors
deferredClips.acting: Individual fingers curl as the eyes scan three imaginary positions, then the palm opens in invitation.

deferredClips.title: Something far away
deferredClips.acting: A tiny distant Wisp forms, turns toward us and follows a curved depth approach, stopping inside the framing reserve.

deferredClips.title: Wrong place, right ghost
deferredClips.acting: From an empty stage, a localized vapor poof forms the whole spirit; hands and core settle with overlap.

deferredClips.title: Gone before you blink
deferredClips.acting: A backward glance, turn away and unravel into wisps until the stage is genuinely empty.

deferredClips.title: A little forbidden magic
deferredClips.acting: Hands gather a modest blue ember, orbit it around the core and snuff it between two fingers.

deferredClips.title: The operator chooses the scare
deferredClips.acting: A short controlled forward feint and immediate recoil; only an armed operator cue, never automatic.
deferredClips.audioIntent: bounded stinger; no sudden full-scale blast

deferredClips.title: The house waits
deferredClips.acting: Intentionally empty black between finished departure and arrival. No stray smoke or orphan eyes.
